author: itaity
body:
A new and very unusual The Walls map:
"Mesoplanet"





Download: 
Album: http://imgur.com/a/4dHXd

Some of the map features: (big thanks to docs.avicus)
*No more boring cuboids teams regions, in this map the teams regions are cylinders!
*Teleporters (yay)!
*Players who leave the domes get jump boost and speed effects in order to resemble the low gravity (and lose it upon reenter)!
